findings.note: Oct 18, 2026 Rotowire note: Kapanen scored on just two shots against the Mammoth and was dropped from the power play after filling in for Zach Hyman on the top unit, so most of his chances will now come at even strength.

Shows 12 shots on goal in 8 games as of Oct 18 (about 1.5 per game, right at the line), with a 17:45 average TOI that was boosted by his top-PP fill-in role. His 2025-26 rate was 65 shots in 41 games, also near 1.5. There are no Oct 18–26 updates, and he had a 7-shot playoff game.

ESPN lists Shea with only 3 shots in his first 5 games of 2026-27 despite playing about 23 minutes a night, with shot counts of 0, 2, 0, 1, 0 in those games and 111 shots in 155 career games; the snapshot may be out of date since the Oilers are 8-1-1.

The Oct 24 NHL.com projected lineup for Maple Leafs at Oilers paired Shea with Connor Murphy, so he looks healthy and in the regular lineup; no injury news turned up, and nothing was found on the Detroit game, power-play usage or analyst picks.

CBS says Shea had his best season in 2025-26 with Pittsburgh (6 goals, 29 assists, 18:53 a game). He is a defensive defenseman who blocks a lot of shots, but his ice time has gone up a lot in Edmonton, which could mean more shot attempts.
